[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]A published bead page lists every commit and agent actually [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]associated with that bead lineage — no matter which of the [/#D7D7AF]

[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]page, and can never again be emptied by a commit made outside the [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]primary repository.[/#D7D7AF]

[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Sidecar-aware primary checkout and owning-project resolver[/bold #D7AFFF]    [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]anchor[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]anchor: add a shared resolver that maps any path inside a managed [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]checkout — including a sidecar or linked-repo clone nested under it — to[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]that checkout's primary repository root and canonical project name, with[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]marker-first resolution and explicit fallbacks.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Anchor bead-page publication and refresh on the resolved [/bold #D7AFFF]     [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
      [bold #D7AFFF]primary repository[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]publish[dim] · [dim][/dim]after anchor[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]publish: stop letting the committing repository masquerade as the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]primary repository by routing the post-commit bead-page publication and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]the pages-refresh CLI through the shared resolver, so a commit made in a[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]sidecar can no longer erase a lineage's associations.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Resolve agent links from any repository in the workspace[/bold #D7AFFF]      [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]agentlinks[dim] · [dim][/dim]after anchor[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]agentlinks: make the hosted agents-sidecar remote lookup and the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]SASE_AGENT commit-footer tag resolve the owning project through the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]shared resolver instead of naming the current working directory's [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]repository, so agent labels stop rendering and committing unlinked.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Associate bead commits across every repository the project [/bold #D7AFFF]   [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
      [bold #D7AFFF]owns[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]multirepo[dim] · [dim][/dim]after anchor, publish[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]multirepo: walk the primary repository plus every locally cloned sidecar[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]and linked repository when deriving bead associations, carry each [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]commit's owning repository through the association records, and resolve [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]commit URLs against that repository's own remote.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  5 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Regenerate degraded pages and verify the sase-b3 lineage end [/bold #D7AFFF] [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
      [bold #D7AFFF]to end[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]repair[dim] · [dim][/dim]after publish, agentlinks, multirepo[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]repair: republish every generated bead page from the corrected [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]projection, confirm the sase-b3 lineage reports the associations its [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]commits prove, and add a guard that fails when a published page links a [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]commit to a sidecar remote.[/#D7D7AF]
